_comment: Wiki course code -> the Burgieclan course its comments belong on.
The split form is for a renumbering: KU Leuven offered OLD up to a point and NEW
after it, so comments before the cutoff stay on the old course (it really did run
then) and later ones move. probe_offering_years.py --suggest drafts these from the
public syllabus archive; check the _evidence line before accepting one.
Do NOT alias two codes that were offered in the SAME years -- those are parallel
courses, not a rename (H04O1A and H04O1B both ran 2010-2025).
Keys starting with _ are ignored. An unknown target code fails the build.
